test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five friends are sitting around a circular table in a club playing cards and facing the center. W is not an immediate neighbour of either X or U. V is not an immediate neighbour of X. U is sitting to the immediate left of X. If Y is sitting between X and W, who will be sitting to immediate right of V?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: U is sitting to the immediate left of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be50ae14de9745aac789e2e95da6e96931b5c9a070bc5e508a55b45b1eacbb2a.png] 

Step 2: Y is sitting between X and W

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ee0ed238951e6def326a1ff3d3fc48bf7d24865cb7dd37a2176ff2d3fcd41d5.png] 

Now we place V at the only spot left,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c91ce728aa217cb150dff4a534aec4fa15b7f0ee53acd46c94cab80c9b1b9bf7.png] 

From the arrangement we can see that, **__U__ is sitting at the immediate right of V.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3).**
